classification_policy: Positive finite values are OBSERVED_VALID; zero is OBSERVED_ZERO_UNVERIFIED; missing or malformed values are not imputed.

execution_eligibility_policy.confirmatory_economic_research: NOT_ELIGIBLE when zero spreads are unverified, required spreads are missing, or verified broker commission/slippage coverage is absent.
execution_eligibility_policy.technical_research: Eligible only within OHLC-integrity-pass windows; unresolved temporal gaps must not be bridged by indicators.

units: MT5 points; no conversion to price or pips
